world.h: ASEAN and China fail to agree South China Sea code
world.b: The Philippines' foreign minister said key issues, including whether the code would be legally binding, remain unresolved after two decades of talks.
world.title: ASEAN, China fall short of agreeing on South China Sea code

world.h: Eisenkot says Netanyahu can't remain PM over alleged vote meddling
world.b: A Channel 12 report alleges Netanyahu's chief of staff sent police after members of the Ra'am party on the eve of the election.
world.title: Eisenkot says Netanyahu can’t remain Israel PM amid alleged vote meddling

world.h: Third US carrier arrives in Middle East, Iran warns it could strike first
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: Third US carrier arrives in Middle East, Iran warns it could strike first

world.h: ASEAN summit opens in Manila with wars topping agenda
world.b: Trump is expected to arrive Tuesday for talks with Southeast Asian leaders after the main meetings conclude.
world.title: Southeast Asian leaders open annual summit with major conflicts and their impact topping the agenda

world.h: Ebola outbreak in Congo remains out of control
world.b: More than 11,000 cases have been recorded six months into the response, and nearly half of those infected have died.
world.title: Ebola outbreak remains out of control in Congo 6 months into response

world.h: Zelenskyy says Starshield limits help Russian energy strikes
world.b: Ukraine's president said speed restrictions on the terminals along the front let drone strikes through, as an Odesa hit left 41,000 households without power.

world.h: Bahrain accuses Iran of attacks to settle score with US
world.b: Bahrain's military said it intercepted several Iranian aerial attacks; the kingdom's Riffa Air Base is used by the US military.

world.h: Saudi coalition intercepts missiles and drones aimed at Riyadh
world.b: The coalition said it destroyed two ballistic missiles and two suspected Houthi drones; Saudi authorities say at least 26 people have been killed in such attacks since September 23.

world.h: Israeli strike targets senior Hamas commander in Khan Younis
world.b: Israel's military said it targeted a senior Hamas commander in a drone strike Saturday that hit a tent sheltering displaced people. Gaza's health ministry says Israeli attacks killed 16 people in 48 hours.

national.h: Two planes collide on Miami airport taxiway
national.b: A Copa Airlines 737's wing struck the nose of a UPS cargo plane Saturday night; two people reported minor injuries.
national.title: 2 planes collide on the ground in Miami, only minor injuries reported

national.h: Tanker's steering failed before New Orleans cruise ship crash
national.b: The NTSB's preliminary finding says the rudder was stuck in a position that sent the Atlantic Asphalt into the American Heritage; the cause is still unclear.
national.title: Officials say a tanker's steering failed before it crashed into a cruise ship in New Orleans

national.h: New Mexico's free childcare for all, one year in
national.b: Parents call universal childcare life-changing, but the state lacks the capacity to meet demand, leaving long waitlists.
national.title: New Mexico wanted free childcare for all. This is what's worked — and what hasn't

national.h: Judge pauses Trump's plan to redevelop DC public golf course
national.b: A federal judge ordered a two-week delay on work at East Potomac Golf Links, which was due to close Sunday for 15 months.

politics.h: Trump's RNC chair faces rebellion after midterm losses
politics.b: Some members want a forensic audit of spending, and the White House is threatening to cut off fundraising help.
politics.title: Trump's handpicked party chair faces a rebellion as midterm losses challenge president's grip on GOP

politics.h: Trump vows to appeal halt to DC golf course project
politics.b: He called the judge's two-week restraining order 'highly destructive and political'.
politics.title: Trump blasts judge’s 2-week halt to his Washington golf project and says administration will appeal

politics.h: Trump breaks silence on ground stop, presses Congress for money
politics.b: The president said upgrading air traffic control shouldn't be done in 'drips and drabs' after a weekend of stranded travelers.

politics.h: Midterms end long GOP dominance in state legislatures
politics.b: Democrats look likely to control 24 legislatures to Republicans' 22, flipping chambers in Pennsylvania, Texas and Georgia.
politics.title: Midterm voters ended the long-running GOP dominance in state legislatures

politics.h: NYC socialists urge Ocasio-Cortez to run for president
politics.b: The city's DSA chapter voted 291 to 123 to encourage a 2028 bid, short of a formal endorsement.

international.h: Indonesia's Prabowo apologizes to neighbors for wildfire haze
international.b: At the ASEAN summit, he said 104 companies are under police investigation over the months-long blazes.
international.title: Indonesian president apologises to Singapore, Malaysia for wildfire haze

international.h: Prince Harry meets Ukraine's Invictus hopefuls in Lviv
international.b: On his fourth wartime visit, he watched athletes vying for Ukraine's largest-ever team for the 2027 games in Birmingham.

international.h: Pope Leo visits Peru's Andes and Amazon
international.b: On the penultimate day of his trip, the pope went to Cusco and Pucallpa, highlighting Indigenous peoples and the environment.
international.title: Pope crosses Peru in the finale of a trip home to visit flock high in Andes and deep in Amazon

international.h: Estonia to close border crossings with Russia
international.b: Tallinn blames Moscow for an attempted arson attack on drone maker Threod Systems; eight people were detained.

international.h: Record 1,488 migrants reach Canary Islands in a day
international.b: Spain's maritime rescue service said most arrived on El Hierro from West Africa on Saturday, beating a 2020 record.

international.h: Thousands rally in Prague against state media funding plan
international.b: Prime Minister Andrej Babis's government wants to replace the household broadcast fee with state budget funding; opponents say it threatens media freedom.

international.h: Cape Verde votes with first woman in presidential race
international.b: President Jose Maria Neves faces opposition candidate Joana Rosa, the first woman to run for president since independence in 1975.

international.h: Francophone summit opens in Cambodia amid Rwanda-DR Congo rift
international.b: Congo has threatened to leave the French-speaking group if Rwanda's Louise Mushikiwabo wins a third term as secretary-general on Monday.

international.h: Jordan sentences three to death over church attack
international.b: A state security court convicted the men of the October gun attack on a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in Karak that killed nine people.

international.h: Iraq's PM fires nine officials over oil smuggling
international.b: Ali al-Zaidi dismissed security officers and a pipeline director after an investigation found illegal refineries in Jurf al-Nasr, a Kataib Hezbollah stronghold.

business.b: NPR traces American Eagle denim to garment workers in Karachi, Pakistan, and their working conditions.

business.h: Bessent says Nvidia should pick an outsider as CEO
business.b: The Treasury secretary said the chipmaker needs 'a dramatic shake-up' after Jensen Huang stepped down Thursday.

sports.h: 49ers beat Cowboys 46-40 in a first-ever NFL score
sports.b: Five fourth-quarter touchdowns produced the 1,099th unique final score in league history.
sports.title: Scorigami: Cowboys-49ers ends with score never before seen in NFL history thanks to Dak Prescott

sports.h: Lions' Aidan Hutchinson feared lost for season
sports.b: The star pass rusher's knee buckled as he celebrated a sack in Detroit's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Germany.
The Yellow Jackets snapped a four-game skid with a largely interim staff and held the Tigers to 228 yards.

sports.h: Ground stop forces NFL to reshuffle Week 10 officials
sports.b: Officials were reassigned to games within driving distance of home, with two referees working as umpires on Sunday.

sports.h: Jeremiah Smith becomes Big Ten's all-time receiving leader
sports.b: The Ohio State star passed Purdue's John Standeford, whose record stood for 23 years, with a 22-yard catch against Northwestern.

sports.h: UFC 334 brings two title fights to Madison Square Garden
sports.b: Ciryl Gane makes his first heavyweight title defense against Josh Hokit in Saturday night's main event.

local.h: Bronx man charged with killing his elderly aunt
local.b: Police say 75-year-old Carmen Nunez was found beaten in the Manida Street home she shared with her nephew, who was charged with murder.
local.title: NYPD says man murdered his elderly aunt at their Bronx home

local.h: DJ survives Flatbush collapse, but his records don't
local.b: Omari Jack lost thousands of reggae records, a collection he values at over $100,000, when his building came down.
local.title: A DJ survived the Brooklyn building collapse: His prized record collection did not

local.h: NY's biggest landfill leaks far more methane than thought
local.b: A report found Seneca Meadows emitting as much as 90 times the federal limit; six of 16 landfills exceeded limits.
local.title: New York's biggest trash dump is releasing even more methane than thought

local.h: NYPD fatally shoots van driver after suspected Coney Island kidnapping
local.b: Police chased the van onto the Belt Parkway after 911 callers reported a woman screaming inside; she escaped unharmed.
local.title: NYPD fatally shoots driver on Belt Parkway following suspected kidnapping

local.h: New Yorkers weigh AI's threat and promise
local.b: At a Latino AI Summit in Manhattan, an Afro-Latina virtual assistant helped deliver the keynote.
local.title: Some in NY fret about being hit by the AI bus. Others are trying to board it.

periods.name: Overnight
periods.text: Partly cloudy, with a low around 41. Northwest wind around 8 mph.

periods.name: Monday
periods.text: Mostly sunny, with a high near 55. Northwest wind 6 to 9 mph.

periods.name: Monday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 42. Northwest wind 6 to 8 mph.

periods.name: Tuesday
periods.text: Sunny, with a high near 59. Northwest wind 6 to 8 mph.

periods.name: Tuesday Night
periods.text: Clear, with a low around 47. West wind around 8 mph.
